findings.title: Kiosk session-loss cascade — CORS 'localhost vs 127.0.0.1' triggers chain (broadcasting CORS → kiosk-token 401 → auto-relogin → wizard state reset → idle screen)
findings.surface: Kiosk wizard (all templates, observed clearest on K1 Sandwich Cayenne)

captures: captures/wave-D/107-K1-07-step-crudite-or-menu-viewport.png (immediately after SUIVANT — wizard collapsed to 'Bienvenue !' idle)
evidence.console_excerpt: Access to XMLHttpRequest at 'http://localhost:8000/api/broadcasting/auth' from origin 'http://127.0.0.1:8000' has been blocked by CORS policy: Response to preflight request doesn't pass access control check: The 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header has a value 'http://localhost:8000' that is not equal to the supplied origin.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: APP_URL=http://localhost:8000 but test/browser opens http://127.0.0.1:8000 → broadcasting/auth CORS mismatch → kiosk session token treated as cross-origin → 401 cascade → frontend auto-relogins via POST /api/auth/kiosk-login → wizard composition state lost → reset to KioskAppComponent idle.
findings.reproduction_constraint: Observed only in dev (host mismatch). Likely DISAPPEARS in production single-host deployment where APP_URL == browser host. Production reproduction REQUIRED before P0 escalation.

proposed_fix.approach_1_env_alignment: Set APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 in .env.testing or align Playwright BASE_URL to localhost. Estimated ~1 LOC config + verify cookie domain.
proposed_fix.approach_2_state_preservation: If reproduces in prod: in resources/js/store/kiosk/* (or KioskAppComponent.vue) — on 401 from session-aware API, retry the auth refresh WITHOUT resetting wizard state. Preserve composition_buffer in sessionStorage before relogin, restore after. Estimated ~30 LOC.
proposed_fix.approach_3_root_fix_cors: config/cors.php — ensure 'allowed_origins' covers BOTH localhost and 127.0.0.1 variants OR resources/js/echo.js — read host from window.location, not hardcoded. Estimated ~5 LOC.
proposed_fix.frozen_zone_concern: KioskWizardComponent.vue + KioskAppComponent.vue are FROZEN per CLAUDE.md §7. Fix MUST live outside wizard components (in store, in echo bootstrap, in CORS config) — never in the frozen Vue files.

findings.title: Pricing preview API rejects payload with HTTP 422 — kiosk reports '[kiosk] pricing preview failed: Request failed with status code 422'
findings.surface: Kiosk wizard sauce step (observed on K1 Sandwich Cayenne 2-sauce selection; K2 Tacos 3-sauce selection; K4 Bols also touched)

captures: captures/wave-D/_console-K1-sandwich-cayenne.log (3× '[kiosk] pricing preview failed: Request failed with status code 422')
evidence.user_visible_signal: Toast 'Tarif rafraîchi localement. Le total est vérifié au paiement.' (yellow info banner, seen on captures/wave-D/204-K2-04-step-menu-or-next-viewport.png)

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: POST payload to /api/frontend/pricing/preview fails server-side validation when sauce-only / supplement-only updates are sent mid-wizard. The frontend has a graceful fallback (local pricing computation) and informs the user, but the 422 is real and consistent. Possible missing required field (e.g. 'item_id' not yet posted, or 'option_ids' formatted incorrectly). Could also be branch_id missing on relogin (chained with F1).

proposed_fix.approach: (1) Capture exact POST body via Network panel intercept during a real session — required before patch. (2) Compare against PricingService::calculateOrder expected shape (app/Services/Pricing/PricingService.php). (3) Either tighten FormRequest validation messages OR fix frontend payload composer to include all required fields before sending preview.
files_to_inspect: resources/js/services/kiosk-pricing.js (or wherever the preview POST is composed)
proposed_fix.investigation_gap: Need exact 422 response body. Run a follow-up probe that logs response.body for the 422s before proposing patch. Without payload, fix is speculative.

findings.title: Out-of-stock sauce 'Algérienne' appears SELECTABLE (orange checkmark badge applied) despite 'Épuisé' label
findings.surface: Kiosk Sandwich wizard sauce step (K1) and Tacos wizard sauce step (K2)

captures: captures/wave-D/203-K2-03-sauces-selected-viewport.png (after script tapped first 3 sauces — Algérienne shows BOTH 'Épuisé' AND orange checkmark badge; composition strip shows 'Algérienne, Andalous...')
evidence.inventory_excerpt: K2 step3 inv menuAddon shows sauce composition added — including the épuisé item

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Épuisé' visual state is purely cosmetic; no click-guard (pointer-events: none, aria-disabled handler, or guarded :click handler) prevents adding an out-of-stock option to composition. Either (a) the card CSS does not set pointer-events: none, or (b) the @click handler does not check item.is_out_of_stock before pushing to composition.
findings.reproduction_constraint: Test script forced the click via direct DOM locator. UNCONFIRMED whether a real user finger-tap would be blocked by CSS layer. Need touch-event reproduction in browser DevTools.

proposed_fix.approach: In KioskStepSauceComponent.vue: add early-return in @click handler if option.is_out_of_stock or option.stock_status === 'out_of_stock'. Belt-and-suspenders: add CSS class .kiosk-sauce-card--epuise { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } on the card when out-of-stock. Estimated 6-10 LOC.
files_to_inspect: resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/steps/KioskStepSauceComponent.vue (NOT in §7 frozen list — KIOSK STEP components are NOT explicitly frozen per CLAUDE.md; only KioskWizardComponent + KioskAppComponent + KioskUpsellComponent are. Verify with owner before edit.)
proposed_fix.frozen_zone_concern: KioskStepSauceComponent.vue is in resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/steps/ — NOT explicitly in §7 frozen list. But owner said 'wizards untouchable'. Confirm scope: are step sub-components included in the wizard freeze? If yes → owner gate required; if no → safe to patch.
